text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It's finally starting... Ikuno Dictus's
Mile Championship...! I'm getting nervous...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan B
text_block_list.text: I know Ikuno Dictus should be fine, but... ugh! I'm still gonna be anxious until the race is over!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list: You seem to be having even more fun than usual today

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oops...
Oh dear, did it show on my face?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Saying that it is fulfilling
would be the most appropriate way to put it, I suppose."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Grabbing hold of my running form at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, and preparing to run in peak condition today through proper management and maintenance—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This Mile Championship will be a culmination
of my growth, of everything
I have worked toward...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That conviction... fills my heart.
choice_data_list: —And you will keep running far into the future.
—And you will keep running far into the future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I'll take what I gained today and turn it into strength to keep running. For a long time, strongly, always."
choice_data_list: That is the kind of Umamusume Ikuno Dictus is.
That is the kind of Umamusume Ikuno Dictus is.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Today, I reach one milestone.
And from there, I will forge ahead anew—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Bear witness together, and then...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please walk beside me again.
From here on out, as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Ikuno Dictus...!
She doesn't seem fatigued at all this time either...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan B
text_block_list.text: "Do your best and stay safe out there today too, Ikuno Dictus~!"
—Ooh~! Hype it up, Ikunoccho!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, going on a brutal rotation right after the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, for real!?
I mean, I'm here today after a pretty rough autumn rotation myself, but—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tbh, Ikunocchi's been racing all year round, right?!
And like, she's ridiculously healthy! Isn't that insane?!
Major respect!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
It seems Helios-san's vibes are riding high as well.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Duh, obviously! Motivation and party vibes through the roof☆
Hype levels at max right now! Woohoo~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna prove I'm the strongest on the mile today!
You better be ready~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on.
I'll show you what I've got, too. Totally top-tier legit.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, now I'm feeling the groove~!
Ikunoccho, I seriously love that about you☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's blow 'em away together!
My-chan, fire it up~!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
What a delightful, pleasant breeze...—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ......Looking at it like this, it really is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Nature-san—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, I'm coming at you ready to test myself
against your veteran aura and all. But—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If you let your guard down... even I might teach you a painful lesson.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Underestimate you? Not a chance.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I will give it my all.
So please, be ready to take everything I've got."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ......Man, I can't compete with this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well then, since this is a match between friends.
It might not be like me,
but maybe I'll get a little fired up...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes—
Let us clash with all our might.
